author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices beats in threes, counting groups of notes, spotting the line that returns, and playing strong and soft, with a German fir-tree song.

classes.title: Sway like a fir tree
classes.goal: Hear the song, sway to its beats in threes, then rest fingers on the lit keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling beats that come in threes: One, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Sway with your child: a big lean on 'one', small on 'two, three'.
classes.childAction: Sway like a tree: big on one, small on two, three.
classes.bridge: The beat sways in threes, like a fir tree in the winter wind.

intro.caption: Let's sway like a fir tree
intro.parentCue: lean big on 'one', small on 'two, three'.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling beats that come in threes.

classes.title: Climb the branches
classes.goal: Learn the first line: three C's, one D, three E's.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three C's, one D, three E's: counting groups of the same

classes.parentPrompt: Play the low G yourself; count the three C's and three E's aloud together.
classes.childAction: Play three C's, one D, then three E's up the branches.
classes.bridge: C, C, C is the low branch; E, E, E is the next branch up.

intro.caption: Climb the tree, branch by branch
intro.parentCue: you play the low G, then your child starts.

games.caption: Three C's, a D, three E's
games.parentCue: Count each group aloud: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting groups of three same notes.

classes.title: Bend and spring back
classes.goal: Learn the branches line: step down one key and right back up.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune steps down one key and comes right back

classes.parentPrompt: Play the low B yourself; your child plays E, D, E, F, then D, C.
classes.childAction: Play E, D, E, F, wait for the low note, then D, C.
classes.bridge: E, D, E is a branch bending in the wind and springing back.

intro.caption: The branches bend in the wind
intro.parentCue: you play the low B; your child plays the rest.

games.caption: Bend and back: E, D, E, F
games.parentCue: Point to each key before it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: stepping one key away and back.

classes.title: The tree line comes back
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and clap each time the tree line returns.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tree line comes three times; the summer line is new

classes.parentPrompt: Clap when 'O Christmas tree' comes back; sing the words if your child stalls.
classes.childAction: Play the song slowly; clap when the tree line comes back.
classes.bridge: Tree, tree, a new summer-and-winter line, then the tree comes home.

intro.caption: Listen for the tree line
intro.parentCue: clap together each time it comes back.

games.caption: Summer line, winter line
games.parentCue: Ask: is the winter line higher or lower?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing which line comes back.

classes.title: Tall branch, tiny twig
classes.goal: Practise the long-short spot slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: One long note, then one quick note, again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Play it slowly, saying 'looong-short', then try it a little faster.
classes.childAction: Hold the first note long, then play a quick one.
classes.bridge: Long-short is a tall branch, then a tiny twig.

intro.caption: Looong-short, looong-short
intro.parentCue: say it aloud as your child plays.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a long note and a quick note.

classes.title: Slow, even steps in three
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly, counting three beats in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting one, two, three keeps every note evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' softly while your child plays slowly.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while you count to three with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Each bar is three even steps around the tree.

intro.caption: Slow and steady wins
intro.parentCue: count one, two, three softly as you go.

games.caption: Tap and count to three
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three out loud

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing evenly, counting to three.

classes.title: The tree on the hilltop
classes.goal: Play the song in a higher place on the piano with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song, moved to a higher home, sounds brighter

classes.parentPrompt: Slide your child's hand up to the higher keys: same fingers, same song.
classes.childAction: Move your hand up high and play the same song.
classes.bridge: The same tree on a hilltop to the right sounds bright as snow.

intro.caption: Same song, up high
intro.parentCue: slide your child's hand up to the right.

games.caption: Same tree, two places
games.parentCue: Ask: which one sounds like snow?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same song in a new place.

classes.title: Play along with the tree
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part going while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit close and nod the beat; if a note is missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes are fine; keep going!
classes.bridge: The music is a sleigh ride; hold on and keep riding.

intro.caption: Play along with the music
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and keep going, whatever happens.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music, together.

classes.title: Tree concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy: summer strong, winter soft.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the summer line strong and the winter line soft

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; whisper 'soft' before the winter line, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play summer strong, winter soft, then bow for teddy.
classes.bridge: Summer is bright and strong; winter is soft as falling snow.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: whisper 'soft' just before the winter line.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing strong and soft, start to end.
